page_results.text: Savills Auctions Home Commercial Residential Nottingham Login / Register View Document Basket Lot 1 250/252 The Broadway Guide Price £290,000-£300,000 Result £358,000 Tenancy & Accommodation (PDF) Please log in to view Legal Pack and Special Conditions Map SC15 Wimbledon 250/252 The Broadway SW19 1SB, Wimbledon, London •   Freehold  Retail Investment •   Let  to Manik Miah  (t/a Broadway Tandoori) until 2018 •   Current  Rent Reserved: £19,500  pa Location The  affluent and popular South-West London suburb of Wimbledon is located approximately  9 miles south-west of Central London, 6 miles east of  Kingston-upon-Thames  and 7 miles north-east of Epsom. The town is well served by road communications  including the A238 and A219 both providing access to the A3 to the west and north-west  respectively, whilst the A24 provides a direct link to the M25 (Junction 9) to the  south. Wimbledon Common, Wimbledon Park and The All England Tennis and Croquet Club  are all close by. Wimbledon (District Line) and Wimbledon South (Northern Line)  underground stations are both close by whilst mainline rail services from Wimbledon  Station to London (Waterloo) have a fastest journey time of about 19 minutes. The  property occupies a prominent position on the north side of The Broadway, close  to the junction with Merton Road (A219) in a mixed residential and commercial area  just to the east of Wimbledon town centre. Nearby occupiers include YMCA Wimbledon,  Majestic Wine, Henry J Beans, a number of local shops and restaurants and The Antoinette  Hotel. Description The  property comprises a prominent three storey terraced building arranged as a ground  floor restaurant with a three bedroom flat arranged over the first and second floors.  The flat requires upgrading and is accessed at the front of the property through  the shop. There is a small rear yard with pedestrian access from Bridge Road Mews. Tenure Freehold. VAT Value  Added Tax is not applicable to this lot. Contact Oliver  Childs +44 (0) 20 7877 4517. E-mail: ochilds@savills.com Michael  Mallie +44 (0) 20 7409  8199. page_results.text: Savills Auctions Home Commercial Residential Nottingham Login / Register View Document Basket Lot 3 1-4 Provident Place, Empson Road Guide Price Sold Prior Result Sold Prior Tenancy & Accommodation (PDF) Please log in to view Legal Pack and Special Conditions Map SC08 Peterborough 1-4 Provident Place, Empson Road, Peterborough PE1 5UU •   Freehold Industrial  Investment •   Established  Industrial Location •   Site  Area about  0.57 Hectares  (1.41 Acres) •   Total  Current Rent Reserved: £87,750  pa (1) On  Instructions from CBRE Investors Location The  cathedral city of Peterborough, with a population of about 162,000, is one of the  fastest growing cities in the UK. It is located about 90 miles north of London and  35 miles north-west of Cambridge. The A1(M) Motorway (Junction 17) is situated 4  miles to the west whilst nearby rail services from Peterborough to London (Kings  Cross) provided by National Express have an approximate journey time of 53 minutes.  Stansted, Luton and East Midlands airports are all within an hour's drive. The  property is located on the north side of Empson Road, which runs between Newark  Road and Edgerley Drain Road, just to the east of Frank Perkins Parkway (A1139)  and within the largest and most established employment area of the city. Nearby  occupiers in the area include Perkins Engines, British Car Auctions, Ideal Home  Shopping plc, Topps Tiles, Travis Perkins, Halfords and Plumb Center. There are  also a number of car dealerships just over one mile to the south of the property  including Jaguar, VW and Volvo. Description The  property comprises a terrace of four industrial/warehouse buildings of steel portal  frame construction with elevations clad in a combination of brick and block work  and insulated profiled metal sheet cladding to an internal eaves height of 5.50  metres (18 ft). Each unit benefits from a loading door to the front elevation and  is arranged as a ground floor production area with concrete first floor mezzanine,  which in some cases has been fitted out as offices. There is adequate car parking  on a site of approximately 0.57 hectares (1.41 acres). Tenure Freehold. VAT Value  Added Tax is applicable to this lot. Contact Oliver  Childs +44 (0) 20 7877 4517. The town is situated close  to the junction of the A691 and A692, whilst the A68 trunk road provides a direct  link to the A1(M) (Junction 58) to the south. Rail services from Durham mainline  station to London (Kings Cross) have a journey time of about 3 hours 6 minutes. The  property occupies a prominent position on the west side of the pedestrianised Middle  Street at the junction with Raglan Street in the town's main retailing area. Nearby  occupiers include Age Concern, Select, Specsavers, Superdrug and HSBC Bank. Description The  property comprises a two storey terraced building arranged as a ground floor shop  with first floor ancillary accommodation. There is parking at the rear for two cars. page_results.text: Savills Auctions Home Commercial Residential Nottingham Login / Register View Document Basket Lot 8 3 Clifton Road, Maida Vale, London Guide Price Withdrawn Prior Result Withdrawn Prior Tenancy & Accommodation (PDF) Please log in to view Legal Pack and Special Conditions Map SC24 Maida Vale 3 Clifton Road Maida Vale, London, W9 1SZ •   Freehold  Retail/ Residential Investment •   Let  to The American Dry Cleaning Company Limited  until 2025 •   Two  Flats Above Sold Off on a Long Lease •   Current  Rent Reserved: £45,000  pa Location Maida  Vale is an affluent and densely populated London suburb within the City of Westminster,  located approximately 2 miles north-west of London's West End, to the north of Hyde  Park and west of Regents Park. Edgware Road (A5) runs to the east of Clifton Road,  providing access to Central London to the south and the M1 Motorway (Junction 1)  to the north. Warwick Avenue (Bakerloo) and Maida Vale (Jubilee Line) underground  stations are a short walk from the property whilst London (Paddington) Mainline  Station is also within easy reach. Lords Cricket Ground is a short walk along St  John Wood Road. page_results.text: Savills Auctions Home Commercial Residential Nottingham Login / Register View Document Basket Lot 11 120 Islington High Street, Islington, London Guide Price £800,000-£1M Result Available at £1M Tenancy & Accommodation (PDF) Please log in to view Legal Pack and Special Conditions Map SC20 Islington 2pg 120 Islington High Street, Islington, London, N1  8EG •   Freehold Retail/   Residential  Building •   Development  Potential for Conversion to  Two Flats •   Camden  Passage Location •   Two  Retail Units •   Current  Rent Reserved: £28,000  pa  Plus  Vacant Residential and Stores •   Vacant Residential    Upper Parts •   Five  Storey Building •   Popular  Antique Market Location •   Two  Retail Units Location Islington  High Street is just off Upper Street in the London Borough of Islington, which has  a resident population of 174,500 and is situated approximately 4 miles from Central  London. The area benefits from excellent transport links including Angel Underground  Station (Northern Line) and numerous bus routes linking the area to Central and  Outer London. Kings Cross Rail Station is also close providing routes from the north  and east of England. The  property is situated on a thriving location on Islington High Street at the edge  of Camden Passage, where there is an excellent selection of shops, boutiques, bars  and restaurants. Description The  property comprises a five storey building arranged as a ground floor and lower ground  floor retail unit and three upper floors of self-contained residential accommodation.  The residential comprises a reception room with sociable open plan kitchen, three  large bedrooms and bathroom. The property benefits from a rear two storey store  and small entrance yard. Planning The  residential upper parts may be suitable for conversion to two flats, subject to  the purchaser obtaining the necessary consents and licences. For further enquiries  please contact Islington Council on Tel: (020) 7527 2000 or visit their website  at www.islington.gov.uk Tenure Freehold. VAT Value  Added Tax is not applicable to this lot. The A414 links  the town with Hatfield, Welwyn Garden City and the M1 Motorway (Junction 4). Regular  rail services from Hertford East and Hertford West mainline stations to London (Moorgate,  Kings Cross and Liverpool Street) have a fastest journey time of about 42 minutes. The  property occupies a prominent position in the pedestrianised town centre Conservation  Area, on the north side of Maidenhead Street, almost opposite Honey Lane and just  to the west of Salisbury Square. The property is adjacent to the Co-Operative Pharmacy  whilst other nearby occupiers include The Edinburgh Woollen Mill, Stead & Simpson,  Oxfam and Clinton Cards. Description The  property comprises a prominent two storey terraced building arranged as a ground  floor shop with first floor storage accommodation. Planning Permission  was granted on appeal (Ref: 3/08/0644/FP dated 01/04/2008) on 11/06/2009 for alterations  to existing shop and development of four studio flats above. The proposed flats  vary in size from 25.45 sq m (274 sq ft) to 40.00 sq m (431 sq ft). These measurements  have been provided by the Seller's Architect. For further enquiries please contact  East Herts District Council on Tel: (01279) 655261 or visit their website at www.eastherts.gov.uk Tenure Freehold. page_results.text: Savills Auctions Home Commercial Residential Nottingham Login / Register View Document Basket Lot 14 Creswicke House, 9-11 Small Street, Bristol, Avon Guide Price £1.4M-£1.6M Result Available at £1.6M Tenancy & Accommodation (PDF) Please log in to view Legal Pack and Special Conditions Map SC21 Bristol 2pg Creswicke House, 9-11 Small Street,  Bristol, Avon BS1 1DB •   Freehold Office Investment •   Let    to Tenants Including Black Horse Finance Holdings Ltd •   Net    Internal Area 1,129.80 sq m    (12,165 sq ft) •   Current    Combined Rent Reserved: £148,920    pa •   Planning Permission    for Residential/ Commercial Redevelopment •   Plans    for 13 Student Flats •   Proposed    Residential Area 1,035 sq m    (11,141 sq ft) •   Proposed    Commercial Area 230.70 sq m     (2,483 sq ft) Location The    City of Bristol has a population of 380,000 and a catchment population in excess    of 865,000. Bristol is located approximately 120 miles west of London and 40 miles    east of Cardiff and it is the largest commercial centre in the South-West of England    and a major centre for higher education, accommodating over 45,000 students. The    city has excellent communications with the M4/M5 Motorway interchange to the north    and the M4 Motorway (Junction 19) accessed via the M32 Motorway from the city centre.    Trains are provided by First Great Western from Bristol (Temple Meads) to London    (Paddington) in 1 hour 38 minutes. Creswicke    House is in a city centre office location on the corner of Colston Avenue and Small    Street near where they meet with Quay Street. Bristol University is within walking    distance and the property sits at the hub of the bus network for easy access to    the campus of the University of the West of England. Nearby offices are occupied    by many well known public and private sector tenants. Description Creswicke    House comprises No. 9 Small Street, a four storey corner office building of traditional    brick construction with a pitched tiled roof probably dating from the mid 19th century,    and Nos 10 and 11 Small Street, a five storey 1980's office building of traditional    brick construction with a mansard roof to the fifth floor. Planning Planning    permission was granted on 01/09/2008 for residential development of the upper floors.    This could provide 13 cluster bed flats specifically designed as student accommodation    providing 41 letting bedrooms in total yet still retaining two commercial units    to the ground floor. For further enquiries contact Bristol City Council on    Tel: (0117) 922 2000 or visit their website at www.bristol.gov.uk/planning. The    planning reference number is 08/01592/LA. Further plans, decision notices and computer    generated images are available to download by registering your interest at www.savills.co.uk/auctions Tenure Freehold. VAT Value    Added Tax is not applicable to this lot. Contact Sandy Hamilton +44 (0) 20 7877 4518. E-mail: shamilton@savills.com Michael  Mallie + 44 (0) 20 7409 8199. E-mail: mmallie@savills.com Seller's    Solicitors Kirby Simcox    (D Curwen Esq) 49-50 Queen Square, Bristol BS1 4LW E-mail: d.curwen@kirbysimcox.co.uk Tel:    (0845) 840 0045 Fax: (0117) 908 3460 Joint    Agent CBRE    (J Broome Esq) Howard House, Queens Avenue, Bristol BS8 1QT E-mail: james.broome@cbre.com Tel:    (0117) 943 5781 Fax: (0117) 943 5757 Document Basket Lot # Remove View and Download Powered by PropertyAuctions.com Auctions 2010 Current Auction Forthcoming Auctions Results of previous auctions Auction venue Auction office Auction information Catalogue Request Addendum Legal Packs

page_results.text: Savills Auctions Home Commercial Residential Nottingham Login / Register View Document Basket Lot 15 235 Queenstown Road, Battersea, London Guide Price Refer Result Refer Accommodation (PDF) Please log in to view Legal Pack and Special Conditions Map SC19 Battersea 2pg 235 Queenstown Road, Battersea, London SW8 3QD •   Prominent  Freehold Residential and Office Buildings including  Car Parking •   Substantial  Dilapidated Mixed Use Building of about 383.50 sq m (4,127 sq ft) •   Includes  an Attractive Secluded Cobbled Mews with Two  Self-Contained Office Buildings  of about 348.85 sq m   (3,755 sq ft) •   To  be Offered as  Two Separate Lots •   Potential  for Refurbishment, Extension, Redevelopment or Alternative Use (Subject to Consents) •   Full  Vacant Possession Location The  affluent and popular South-West London suburb of Battersea, located within the London  Borough of Wandsworth, is approximately 3 miles  south-west of Central London  on the south bank of the River Thames close to Chelsea Bridge. The area benefits  from excellent communications being served by Queenstown Road and Battersea Park  Mainline Rail Stations less than 0.5 miles to the north, whilst Clapham Junction  Mainline Station, Britain's busiest railway station, is also close by and provides  regular train services into London (Waterloo) with journey times of only a few minutes. The  properties are conveniently situated in a prominent position on the west side of  Queenstown Road at the junction with Silverthorne Road, in a mainly residential  area, a short walk from the recreational amenities at Battersea Park to the north.  The local area will be improved further with the proposed major redevelopments of  Battersea Power Station and a section of Nine Elms Lane to include the new US Embassy. Description Lot  15 – 235 Queenstown Road (shaded pink on the plan) comprises a prominent part  two, part three storey building of about 383.50 sq m  (4,127 sq ft) arranged  as ground floor premises previously used as offices/storage with residential accommodation  on the first and second floors. Access to the second floor is restricted through  a hatch in the ceiling. The entire property is dilapidated and would benefit from  complete refurbishment, possible extension or redevelopment subject to obtaining  the necessary consents. Because the property is in a poor state of repair, prospective  buyers are advised to view the property at their own risk. Savills and their clients  take no responsibility for any accidents, losses or injury incurred while viewing  the property. Lot  16 – 1 &  2 Queenstown Mews (shaded blue on the plan) comprises two detached two storey self-contained  office buildings situated within a wonderful secluded gated cobbled mews to the  rear of 235 Queenstown Road. The buildings were both refurbished a few years ago  to a good specification and benefit from superb natural light, perimeter cable trunking,  male and female WCs, electric heating and secure mews parking. There is a garage  providing further parking and storage incorporated in Building 2. Planning There  could be potential for change of use, to extend or to redevelop all or part of the  site subject to obtaining all of the necessary consents. For further information  please contact The London Borough of Wandsworth on Tel: (020) 8871 6000 or visit  their website at www.wandsworth.gov.uk Tenure Freehold. VAT Value  Added Tax is not applicable to this lot. Contact Oliver  Childs +44 (0) 20 7877 4517. E-mail: ochilds@savills.com Rebecca  Garnett +44 (0) 20  7877 4515. E-mail: rgarnett@savills.com Seller's  Solicitors WSM Solicitors  LLP (J Weller Esq) Woodcock House, Gibbard Mews, 37-38 High Street, Wimbledon  Village, London SW19 5BY E-mail: jeremy.weller@wsmsolicitors.com Tel:  (020) 8879 4300 Fax: (020) 8946 8073 The  Seller reserves the right to offer the lots together as one lot or in any combination Document Basket Lot # Remove View and Download Powered by PropertyAuctions.com Auctions 2010 Current Auction Forthcoming Auctions Results of previous auctions Auction venue Auction office Auction information Catalogue Request Addendum Legal Packs

page_results.text: Savills Auctions Home Commercial Residential Nottingham Login / Register View Document Basket Lot 18 322 Burdett Road, Limehouse, London Guide Price £600,000+ Result Available at £650,000 Tenancy & Accommodation (PDF) Please log in to view Legal Pack and Special Conditions Map sc07 322 Burdett Road,  Limehouse, London E14 7DL •   Freehold Restaurant/  Residential Investment •   Includes  Three  Self-Contained Flats •   Total  Current Rent Reserved: £58,760  pa  Plus  Vacant Flat Location Limehouse  is located within the London Borough of Tower Hamlets between Canary Wharf and the  City of London. It is on the northern bank of the River Thames close to the Rotherhithe  tunnel and the A13 trunk road. Nearby  Limehouse Station serves the mainline trains out to Essex and Docklands Light Railway,  which is two stops from Bank and Tower Gateway in the City of London. The  property is situated on the west side of Burdett Road in close proximity to the  West India Millwall Docks and Westferry and Limehouse underground and overground  stations. Nearby occupiers in the vicinity include Lidl, Ladbrokes, Coral and Domino's  in this mixed commercial and residential area. Description The  property comprises a four storey building arranged as a recently refurbished ground  floor shop and basement with three self-contained one bedroom flats each arranged  over first, second and third floors with access from the front. All the flats have  been refurbished and comprise reception/kitchen, shower and bedroom. Tenure Freehold. VAT Value  Added Tax is NOT applicable to this lot. page_results.text: Savills Auctions Home Commercial Residential Nottingham Login / Register View Document Basket Lot 19 48 Chertsey Road, Woking, Surrey Guide Price Sold Prior Result Sold Prior Accommodation (PDF) Please log in to view Legal Pack and Special Conditions Map SC03 Woking 48 Chertsey Road, Woking, Surrey GU21  5BG •   Freehold Retail/   Residential  Building •   Requiring  Complete Refurbishment •   Gross  Internal Area  223.12 sq m   (2,401 sq ft) •   Full  Vacant Possession On  Instructions from  S Martin and S Jones  as Joint LPA Receivers Location Woking,  with a population of 62,000, functions as a dormitory town in the London commuter  belt, located 23 miles south-west of Central London,  10 miles north of Guildford  and 30 miles south-east of Reading. The town benefits from excellent road communications  being situated 7 miles west of the M25 Motorway (Junction 10) and 6 miles south  of the M3 Motorway (Junction 3), Both Motorways provide direct access to Central  London and  South-West England. Rail services to London (Waterloo) run regularly  from Woking with a journey time of approximately 25 minutes. The  property is situated on the west side of Chertsey Road, close to the junction with  Church Street East within Woking town centre and approximately 250 metres north-east  of Woking Rail Station. Description The  property comprises a two storey building arranged as a ground floor former restaurant  with residential accommodation above. There is a separate front entrance to the  first floor residential accommodation, which requires complete refurbishment and  includes four rooms and a WC/shower room. Tenure Freehold. Planning For  all planning enquiries please contact Woking Borough Council on Tel: (01483) 755855  or visit their website at www.woking.gov.uk VAT Value  Added Tax is not applicable to this lot. page_results.text: Savills Auctions Home Commercial Residential Nottingham Login / Register View Document Basket Lot 21 8 High Street, Dymchurch, Kent Guide Price Withdrawn Prior Result Withdrawn Prior Accommodation (PDF) Please log in to view Legal Pack and Special Conditions Map SC06 Dymchurch 8 High Street, Dymchurch, Kent TN29 0NG •   Freehold  Retail Premises •   Tourist  Location •   Net  Internal Area  13.00 sq m (140 sq ft) On  Instructions from the Mortgagees (Not in Possession) Location Dymchurch  is a coastal village on the edge of Romney Marsh in the Shepway district of Kent  which has a district population of 96,400. The village is approximately 5 miles  to the south-west of Hythe and approximately 3 miles to the north-east of New Romney.  The popular coastal towns of Rye and Camber are 8 miles to the west and the area  benefits from a large influx of holidaymakers in the summer months. The  A259 coastal road passes through the village and the M20 Motorway (Junction 11)  is approximately 8 miles to the north. The Romney, Hythe and Dymchurch narrow gauge  railway also passes through the village. The  property is situated on the south-eastern side of the High Street opposite the junction  with Mill Road. The property is within an established retail trading area characterised  by local independent traders. Adjacent occupiers include a Hospice Bookshop and  Tandoori Takeaway. Description The  property comprises a single storey mid terrace lock-up shop fronting Dymchurch High  Street. No. 6 High Street, to the south, extends around the rear of the property.  The subject property accordingly has party walls to both sides and the rear. Tenure Freehold.  The property is being offered for sale by the mortgagee NOT in possession. Vacant  possession cannot be guaranteed on completion and the property will be sold subject  to any leases, licences or occupancies that may exist. Buyers are advised to satisfy  themselves by making their own enquiries. VAT Value  Added Tax is not applicable to this lot. Contact Sandy Hamilton +44 (0) 20 7877 4518. Email: shamilton@savills.com Rebecca  Garnett +44 (0) 20 7877 4515.
